findings.title: The removal diff's trust gate reads the previous poll's state, and crashes on the first refresh
findings.why_it_matters: app_list_trusted inside _async_update_data reads the previous poll and raises on the first refresh
findings.chosen: Gate the diff on this poll's own health.bootstrap_released with the fresh listing; never call app_list_trusted there

findings.title: A declared entity's child device needs its parent app device registered first, and nothing guarantees that
findings.why_it_matters: HA aborts a child-device entity whose parent isn't registered; platforms set up concurrently
findings.recommended: A: The coordinator registers the app device in its poll pass
findings.chosen: A: The coordinator registers the app device in its poll pass

findings.title: The add rule, availability and D13's removal rule disagree about instances outside hassette's config
findings.why_it_matters: A user's deletion of an out-of-config instance's device is undone by the next poll
findings.recommended: B: Mirror wanted(); available while running, in config or not
findings.chosen: B: Mirror wanted(); available while running, in config or not

findings.title: One poll's absence removes a declared entity (and an instance's device) with no stated reason why that's safe
findings.why_it_matters: Removal relies on HA's deleted-entity restore without saying so
findings.recommended: A: Keep one-poll removal; write down why it's safe
findings.chosen: A: Keep one-poll removal; write down why it's safe

findings.title: The 2026.11 Home Assistant minimum rests on a premise the evidence contradicts
findings.why_it_matters: Child devices date to HA 2026.9; D1 recorded the wrong reason for the floor
findings.recommended: A: Keep 2026.11, correct D1's stated reason
findings.chosen: A: Keep 2026.11, correct D1's stated reason

findings.title: An instance whose entities is None could be read as declaring nothing
findings.why_it_matters: Silent wholesale removal if None is read as []
findings.recommended: A: Skip None instances in the add path and the diff (with a test)
findings.chosen: A: Skip None instances in the add path and the diff (with a test)

findings.title: A sensor value HA still rejects after D4's parsing leaves the sensor stuck with a traceback every poll
findings.why_it_matters: Naive timestamps or unknown classes still fail every poll
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: After a toggle, the action refresh usually shows the old switch state for up to 30 s
findings.why_it_matters: Switch snaps back with no explanation until push lands
findings.recommended: A: State the snap-back in the README section
findings.chosen: B: Leave it recorded only in Assumed
findings.choice_reason: 73 will ship at the same time/same release, so we can probably ignore this one

findings.title: The per-poll registry removal makes D3's 'the next poll heals it' false
The diff must be scoped to this config entry
Destructive registry removals are logged at DEBUG only
findings.why_it_matters: A user whose entity vanishes gets no log line
findings.chosen: Change _LOGGER.debug to _LOGGER.info on the two removal lines

findings.title: README still offers HACS on earlier versions below the new 2026.11 floor
findings.why_it_matters: Requirements contradict the new HA minimum
findings.chosen: Change the README line to Marketplace or HACS

findings.title: Ledger invariants behind the destructive diff have no test pinning them
findings.why_it_matters: Safety statements behind one-poll removal could regress silently
findings.chosen: Add five tests pinning the invariants; no production code

findings.title: A declared switch's attributes are silently dropped
findings.why_it_matters: hassette's IntegrationSwitch.set(attributes=) does nothing in HA
findings.recommended: A: Move extra_state_attributes (returning declared.attributes or None) from HassetteDeclaredSensor into HassetteDeclaredEntity, so switches show their attributes, and add a switch test next to test_switch_shows_the_declared_value
findings.chosen: A: Move extra_state_attributes (returning declared.attributes or None) from HassetteDeclaredSensor into HassetteDeclaredEntity, so switches show their attributes, and add a switch test next to test_switch_shows_the_declared_value

findings.title: An unknown device or state class on an already-added sensor raises on every state write
findings.why_it_matters: The sensor freezes while still available, with a traceback each poll
findings.recommended: B: Make the device_class/state_class properties return None for a class this HA doesn't know, logging once per value
findings.chosen: B: Make the device_class/state_class properties return None for a class this HA doesn't know, logging once per value
findings.choice_reason: Asked what peers do first; ESPHome's try_parse_enum degrades to no class on add and update, which changed the recommendation from A to B

findings.title: The new registry mutations run inside the poll with no containment
findings.why_it_matters: A registry error would fail every poll
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: an unexpected registry error in the declared-entity steps fails the whole poll, and every entity goes unavailable until it's fixed
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: an unexpected registry error in the declared-entity steps fails the whole poll, and every entity goes unavailable until it's fixed

findings.title: may_add_declared checks the registry across every config entry, not just this one
findings.why_it_matters: Two hassette entries can clash on a unique_id
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: with two hassette entries sharing an app and instance name, an out-of-config instance's entity can collide with the other entry's and is skipped with a logged unique_id clash
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: with two hassette entries sharing an app and instance name, an out-of-config instance's entity can collide with the other entry's and is skipped with a logged unique_id clash

findings.title: App-supplied attributes can overwrite or inject HA-owned sensor attributes
findings.why_it_matters: A reserved attribute name can change statistics behavior
findings.recommended: C: Accept as a known limitation: an app attribute that uses an HA-reserved name overrides or injects that attribute in HA
findings.chosen: C: Accept as a known limitation: an app attribute that uses an HA-reserved name overrides or injects that attribute in HA
